basic_details.job_title: UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 336 Anganwadi Worker Posts in Meerut District
basic_details.organization_name: District Program Officer, ICDS (Bal Vikas Seva evam Pushtahar), Meerut, Uttar Pradesh
basic_details.short_information: The District Program Officer, ICDS (Integrated Child Development Services), Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, has invited online applications for 313 Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper) posts across urban and rural project areas of Meerut district. Only female candidates who are permanent residents of the concerned Gram Sabha or Ward are eligible. Online applications can be submitted at upanganwadibharti.in from July 22, 2026 to August 11, 2026 (midnight).

age_limit.details: Minimum Age Maximum Age 18 years 35 years | The date of birth recorded in the candidate's High School mark sheet/certificate will be considered valid for age calculation.

qualification.details: Minimum: Intermediate (12th pass) Maximum: Postgraduate The merit list will be prepared based on the candidate's educational qualification within this range. | The date of birth recorded in the candidate's High School mark sheet/certificate will be considered valid for age calculation. | Only female candidates are eligible to apply for these posts. The candidate must be a permanent resident of the Gram Sabha/Ward (for urban areas) corresponding to the vacant post applied for. Applications from candidates belonging to any other Gram Sabha/Ward will not be considered valid.

selection_process: There is no written examination for this recruitment. Selection is based on a merit list prepared according to the candidate's educational qualification

as per the criteria laid down in Uttar Pradesh Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687) dated 17.09.2025. A district-level Selection Committee has been constituted for this recruitment
and the Committee's decision will be final and binding.
how_to_apply: Visit the official departmental website: upanganwadibharti.in
Locate the online application link for the Anganwadi Sahayika recruitment for Meerut district.
Select the relevant project and Gram Sabha/Ward for which you are a permanent resident and wish to apply.
Fill in personal, educational, age, and residence-related details accurately.
Upload legible, self-attested scanned copies of all required certificates and mark sheets.
Review all entries carefully before final submission, as incorrect or forged information will lead to rejection of the application without notice.
Submit the application within the specified window, i.e., on or before 11.08.2026, midnight. Offline or postal applications will not be accepted under any circumstances.
important_instructions: Only online applications submitted through upanganwadibharti.in within the prescribed time window will be accepted; offline or postal applications will not be considered valid or accepted under any circumstances. If any error is found in the application, or if any facts, figures, or educational records are found to be incorrect or forged, the application will be rejected without prior notice, and the applicant will be solely responsible for any such error. Candidates should note that there is no provision for correction of applications after submission; errors must be avoided at the time of filling the form. Income certificates will be accepted only if issued by a competent authority at the Tehsil level, in accordance with the applicable Uttar Pradesh Revenue Department government orders, and must be capable of online verification. Caste and residence certificates will be accepted only if issued online by the Tehsil with digital signature and capable of online verification. Detailed proforma and additional information are available on upanganwadibharti.in; further information can also be obtained from the concerned Vikas Khand's Child Development Project office or from the District Program Officer (Child Development Department) office at Vikas Bhavan. The final selection will be made strictly as per the process outlined in Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687) dated 17.09.2025, and the decision of the district-level Selection Committee will be final.

content_sections.heading: ICDS Meerut Anganwadi Sahayika Notification 2026 PDF Out
content_sections.text: The notification has been issued by the Office of the District Program Officer (ICDS), Meerut, as per Uttar Pradesh Government Order (Shasanadesh) No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687) dated 17.09.2025. Recruitment is being conducted for vacant, honorarium-based Anganwadi Sahayika posts in the Child Development Projects (Bal Vikas Pariyojnas) operating in the urban and rural areas of Meerut district, through a direct online application process on the departmental website upanganwadibharti.in. content_sections.heading: ICDS Meerut Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
ICDS Meerut Anganwadi Sahayika Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: Village Sabha/Ward-wise vacancy details along with reservation and complete eligibility criteria are displayed on the notice boards of the District Collectorate, Vikas Bhavan, Tehsil, and Development Block offices of Meerut, and are also uploaded on upanganwadibharti.in. The number of advertised vacant posts may increase or decrease depending on special circumstances.

content_sections.heading: ICDS Meerut Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Minimum: Intermediate (12th pass) Maximum: Postgraduate The merit list will be prepared based on the candidate's educational qualification within this range. The date of birth recorded in the candidate's High School mark sheet/certificate will be considered valid for age calculation. Only female candidates are eligible to apply for these posts. The candidate must be a permanent resident of the Gram Sabha/Ward (for urban areas) corresponding to the vacant post applied for. Applications from candidates belonging to any other Gram Sabha/Ward will not be considered valid.

content_sections.heading: ICDS Meerut Anganwadi Sahayika 2026 Honorarium
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be appointed on an honorarium (मानदेय) basis, as per the applicable Uttar Pradesh Government Order. The exact monthly honorarium amount is not specified in this notification.

content_sections.heading: ICDS Meerut Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: There is no written examination for this recruitment. Selection is based on a merit list prepared according to the candidate's educational qualification, as per the criteria laid down in Uttar Pradesh Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687) dated 17.09.2025. A district-level Selection Committee has been constituted for this recruitment, and the Committee's decision will be final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for ICDS Meerut Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: High School mark sheet/certificate (for age proof) Educational qualification mark sheets and certificates (Intermediate up to Postgraduate, as applicable) Income certificate issued at the Tehsil level (online, digitally signed), where applicable for BPL/income-based criteria Caste certificate issued online at the Tehsil level with digital signature, where applicable Residence certificate issued online at the Tehsil level with digital signature Any other proof of permanent residence in the concerned Gram Sabha/Ward All uploaded educational records and other certificates must be legible, self-attested copies.
